title: Nyansa a Ahintaw no Akoa
intro: Wɔ Kur’aan mu nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw so kɛse no mu no, ahintasɛm bi gyina hɔ, Allah akoa a wɔde ɔsoro nimdeɛ ne mmɔborohunu adom no. Saa ahintasɛm nipa yi ne adiyifo akɛse no mu biako twaa akwan, na ɛde akwantu a nneyɛe a ɛyɛ nwonwa ahyɛ mu ma a ɛkasa tia nnipa ntease anohyeto ahorow. Ɛwom sɛ na adeyɛ biara te sɛ nea ɛnteɛ de, nanso na ɛde nkrabea, boasetɔ, ne nyansa a wonhu a ɛwɔ ɔsoro ahyɛde akyi ho asuade ahorow a emu dɔ siei. Hena ne saa onipa a ɔyɛ sunsuma yi, na nokware ahorow bɛn na wɔdaa no adi?
clues: Na meyɛ Allah akoa, a wɔayi me ama nimdeɛ soronko ne mmɔborɔhunu.
Odiyifo kɛse bi hwehwɛɛ sɛ obesua biribi afi me hɔ, na mepenee so wɔ tebea horow a emu yɛ den mu.
Wɔ yɛn nhyiam no mu no, meyɛɛ nneɛma abiɛsa a na ɛte sɛ nea ɛnteɛ mma me hokafo no.
Mesɛee hyɛmma bi a ɛyɛ ahiafo de, nanso na ɛyɛ mmɔborohunu a ahintaw.
Mikum abarimaa kumaa bi nkwa, ɛwom sɛ na ɛte sɛ nea ɛyɛ atirimɔdensɛm de, nanso na ɛyɛ sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a n’awofo anni awerɛhow.
Mesan sii ɔfasu bi wɔ kurow bi a na ɛnsɛ sɛ yɛma yɛn ahɔhoyɛ mu, na ɛdaa ademude bi adi wɔ n’ase.

arabic: فَوَجَدَا عَبْدًۭا مِّنْ عِبَادِنَآ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنْ عِندِنَا وَعَلَّمْنَـٰهُ مِن لَّدُنَّا عِلْمًۭا
verse: And they found a servant from among Our servants [i.e., al-Khiḍr] to whom We had given mercy from Us and had taught him from Us a [certain] knowledge. (18:65)
